Possession day is when a flat buyer's leverage is highest, and most people spend it on photos.

Under the RERA Act 2016, defects reported within 5 years of handover must be rectified by the promoter free of charge within 30 days (Sec 14(3)). That right is only as good as the record behind it.
A practical handover checklist: obtain the occupancy certificate (Sec 11(4)(b)), verify carpet area against the agreement (Sec 2(k)), test water, walls and wiring, match fittings to the specification, issue a dated snag list with photos, and confirm the conveyance deed timeline (Sec 17(1)).
